note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; relationships, statuses and the traversal order are supplied by the author and nothing is decided by the animation.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional guest-pass rule with two alternative routes: the parts separate, the rule is related to both inlets (plain relations, no arrowheads), each inlet leads to the junction and the junction to the point of analysis (sequences). The tracer runs from Route A through the junction to the point while the magnifier enlarges the shuttle valve and the ball closes the B seat; both facts are supplied.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library-fee rule where Route A's fact is PENDING (nothing sent) and Route B's fact is supplied. The tracer follows Route B instead (portB → junction → point), the magnifier enlarges Route B's inlet, and the arriving route pushes the ball the other way (against the A seat). The rule–inlet links are supplied as communication for Route B.

presets.description: Long names and texts near the field limits: long rule caption, conditions, facts, element labels and relation captions, two long assumptions and a long issue. Text wraps between words; sizes stay at or above 16 px at 1080p.
